title: 67dle - The 67 Number Game
tagline: Use four numbers and maths to make 67
description: A daily math puzzle. Combine four numbers with +, −, ×, ÷, ^ and ! to hit exactly 67.

title: Yeardle - Guess the year
tagline: Guess the year a historical event happened
description: A daily history puzzle — read the clue on the flashcard and guess the year in 5 tries.

title: Daily Hangman
tagline: Draw your guess in chalk
description: A daily hangman puzzle — The classic hangman game where you guess letters one at a time until you get the word. Don't let that man hang!

title: Shikaku
tagline: Every number is a rectangle's area
description: A daily rectangle-division logic puzzle — draw rectangles so each one contains exactly one number, matching its area, until the whole grid is covered.

title: Sudoku-dle
tagline: Fill every row, column and box with 1-9
description: A daily Sudoku puzzle — fill the 9×9 grid so every row, column and box holds the digits 1–9, exactly once each.

title: Mini Sudoku-dle
tagline: A quicker 6x6 Sudoku, solved in minutes
description: A quick daily Mini Sudoku — fill the 6×6 grid so every row, column and 2×3 box holds the digits 1–6, exactly once each.

title: Define-dle
tagline: Guess the word from its definition
description: A daily word puzzle — read the dictionary definition and guess the word. Unlimited guesses, with Wordle-style letter feedback after each try.

title: Crossword-dle Mini
tagline: A tiny crossword, just three words
description: A tiny daily crossword — just three overlapping words and three clues. Quick enough for a coffee break, with a new grid every day.

title: Crossword-dle
tagline: A full daily crossword, 30 clues
description: A full daily crossword — a 9×9 grid with around 30 words, clued across and down. A bigger daily challenge than Crossword-dle Mini.

title: Cryptic-dle
tagline: One cryptic crossword clue, one word to guess
description: A daily cryptic crossword clue — crack the anagram, hidden word, reversal, charade, double definition or homophone, then guess the word. Unlimited guesses, but no letter-by-letter hints — the clue is the only way in.

title: Sequence-dle
tagline: Spot the pattern, fill the gaps
description: A daily number sequence puzzle — a couple of numbers are missing from the sequence. Work out the pattern and fill them in. Unlimited guesses.

title: Flow-dle
tagline: Connect the dots, don't cross the lines
description: A daily pipe-connecting logic puzzle — link every pair of matching coloured dots on an 8×8 grid without crossing a line, filling every cell to solve it.

title: Match-dle
tagline: Flip two, find the pair
description: A daily memory-matching puzzle — flip two tiles at a time and clear the board by finding all eight matching shape pairs on a 4×4 grid.

title: Node-dle
tagline: Trace every line. Never lift twice.
description: A daily one-line tracing puzzle. Every board is a fixed network of nodes with grey connections already drawn between them — drag across each one to trace it, without ever retracing the same line twice. It's always possible to trace the whole board in a single unbroken stroke; the fewer times you lift and restart, the better your score.

title: Stop the Clock
tagline: Feel the seconds. Stop on the dot.
description: A daily timing game. Today's number is a random whole number of seconds from 1 to 30 — hit Start, then hit Stop the instant you think that many seconds have passed. There's no visible clock while it's running, just your own sense of time. Try as many times as you like; your closest attempt is your best for the day.

title: Blackjack-dle
tagline: One hand a day, dealer included
description: A daily blackjack puzzle — one hand against the dealer, dealt from the same shuffle as everyone else. Hit, stand or double down, then come back tomorrow for a new shoe.

title: Connectly
tagline: One path, every cell, in order
description: A daily grid-tracing puzzle — connect the numbered dots in order with a single path that fills every cell on the 6×6 grid, without crossing or lifting.

title: Guess the Word
tagline: Five letters, six guesses, one word a day
description: A daily five-letter word puzzle — guess the secret word in six tries, with every guess coloring in how close each letter was.

title: Block Breaker: Levels
tagline: Five hand-built levels, then forever
description: A clean, minimal brick breaker. Clear five designed levels — a classic grid, a crown, a smiley, a broken heart and a galaxy — then keep going in Infinity Mode. Multi-ball, mega-ball and explosive power-ups included.

title: Block Breaker: Infinity
tagline: Endless levels, faster every time
description: Block Breaker's endless mode. Procedurally generated layouts keep coming, and the ball speeds up after every level you clear. How far can you get before you run out of lives?

title: Brick Breaker: Levels
tagline: Retro neon brick smashing
description: A classic retro-arcade brick breaker in neon. Clear five designed levels — a rainbow wall, a space invader, a smiley, a broken heart and a galaxy — then carry on into Infinity Mode.

title: Brick Breaker: Infinity
tagline: Endless neon levels, ever faster
description: Brick Breaker's endless mode. Procedurally generated neon layouts keep coming and the ball speeds up after every level you clear.

title: Chop Shop Chef
tagline: Slice the veg, dodge the bombs
description: Swipe across the flying vegetables to slice them. Don't let three fall uncut, and never slice a bomb. Chain slices in one swipe for combo points — it gets faster the longer you last.

title: Flappy Turd
tagline: Flap through the sewer pipes
description: Flap your way through the sewer pipes without getting flushed. One tap to flap, one hit and it's over. Unlock the Golden Turd skin for free from the Skins menu.

title: Maze Muncher
tagline: Clear the maze, dodge the Thornbugs
description: Crunch every seed in the maze while dodging the Thornbugs. Grab a star-berry to turn the tables and munch them for bonus points.

title: Ping 360
tagline: Keep the ball inside the ring
description: Pong in a circle. Slide your paddle around the ring and keep the ball alive at the centre — it only gets faster.

title: Pings and Pongs
tagline: Classic pong against the computer
description: Classic two-paddle pong against the computer. Keep the volley alive and score past the CPU before it scores past you — the ball speeds up as you level up.

tagline: Slide, merge, reach 2048
description: Slide the tiles and merge matching numbers. Reach the 2048 tile — then keep going for an even bigger score.

title: Snake
tagline: Eat the dots, don't bite yourself
description: The classic. Eat the dots to grow longer, and don't hit the walls or your own tail. The snake speeds up as you score.

title: Tetromino
tagline: Falling blocks, clear the lines
description: A falling-block puzzle on an 11-wide board with eight shapes, a ghost piece, hard drop, and a Skip button on a 30-second cooldown. Clear lines to level up.

title: Rise
tagline: Steer your balloon ever higher
description: One balloon, one life. Steer through the sky as it gets faster the higher you go, grab helium for a shield, and graze hazards for close-call bonuses.

title: Skyguard
tagline: Shield your balloon from falling shapes
description: Your hot-air balloon climbs through a storm of falling debris. Steer the shield to knock shapes out of the way, and climb as high as you can before you run out of lives.

title: Sweet Smash
tagline: Endless candy match-3
description: Swap neighbouring candies to line up three or more. Cascades chain into combos. No timer and no move limit — play until the board runs out of moves.

title: Tanks
tagline: Bounce shots, clear the arena
description: Roll into a walled arena and clear out waves of enemy tanks. Shots ricochet off walls, so use the angles — and drop a mine when things get crowded.

title: Galactic Defenders: Sector Alpha
tagline: Hold the line, wave after wave
description: Earth's last gunner. Blast wave after wave of descending aliens, grab power-ups and take down the boss. Sector Alpha is the original, balanced defense line.

title: Galactic Defenders: Sector Omega
tagline: Splitter drones and piercing rounds
description: The harder sector. Splitter drones break apart when hit, you get piercing rounds, and the boss calls for backup.

title: Meteor Madness
tagline: Dodge meteors, survive the storm
description: Pilot your ship through an endless meteor storm. Dodge the rocks, grab power-ups, and see how long you can survive as it gets faster every minute.

title: Meteor Madness: Party
tagline: Up to 4 players, last ship flying wins
description: Local multiplayer Meteor Madness for 2 to 4 players on one device. Everyone dodges the same meteor storm — last ship flying wins.

title: Minesweeper: Beginner
tagline: 9×9 board, 10 mines
description: Classic Minesweeper on a 9×9 board with 10 mines. Your first click is always safe; numbers show how many mines touch each square.

title: Minesweeper: Intermediate
tagline: 16×16 board, 40 mines
description: Classic Minesweeper on a 16×16 board with 40 mines. First click is always safe, flood-fill reveal and chording included.

title: Minesweeper: Expert
tagline: 30×16 board, 99 mines
description: Classic Minesweeper on the full 30×16 expert board with 99 mines. First click is always safe — after that it's all logic.

title: Chess vs Computer: Easy
tagline: A gentle computer opponent
description: Full chess against an Easy computer opponent that blunders fairly often — good for beginners. All the rules: castling, en passant, promotion, and every kind of draw.

title: Chess vs Computer: Medium
tagline: Solid, consistent computer play
description: Full chess against a Medium computer opponent — solid and consistent, but still beatable.

title: Chess vs Computer: Hard
tagline: A computer that thinks ahead
description: Full chess against the Hard computer, which searches several moves deep and rarely makes a mistake.

title: Chess: 2 Players
tagline: Pass and play with a friend
description: Two-player chess on one device. White moves first and the board flips to face whoever's turn it is.

title: Tic Tac Toe vs AI: Easy
tagline: Three in a row against an easy AI
description: Simple, fast tic tac toe against an Easy AI. Choose whether you go first as X or second as O.

title: Tic Tac Toe vs AI: Hard
tagline: Can you beat (or draw) the perfect AI?
description: Tic tac toe against the Hard AI, which plays perfectly. A draw is a good result — can you find a win when it slips?

title: Tic Tac Toe: 2 Players
tagline: Noughts and crosses with a friend
description: Two-player tic tac toe on the same device. Take turns placing X and O — first to three in a row wins.

title: Up You Go: Cloud Kingdom
tagline: Bounce as high as you can
description: Bounce from platform to platform and climb as high as you can without falling. Cloud Kingdom is the original world — no gimmicks, just good bouncing.

title: Up You Go: Ember Peaks
tagline: Ride the updraft vents
description: Up You Go in the volcanic Ember Peaks, where updraft vents launch you into a soaring, low-gravity climb.

title: Up You Go: Frostbite Summit
tagline: Wind gusts shove you sideways
description: Up You Go on the icy Frostbite Summit, where wind-gust tiles shove you hard sideways — great for crossing wide gaps.
